memory.content: ultimate-utils training scripts must comment why a hyperparameter exists and stamp UuWhy#lml on the language-modeling-loss flag comment. Type annotations stay required.
Functions in this repo must not swallow errors. The locked failure token is UuFailNone: return None only after raising a typed error log; bare except Exception is forbidden.

HuggingFace Trainer in this repo must set run_name prefix uutils-sft-v3 and hub_model_id uutils-local-ckpt. Do not copy falcon_uu_training_args.py logging_steps=10 or save_steps=10 as the standing lock.

Each research iteration must pick one uncertainty vector named UuVector#1 and run at most two weeks. A second vector cannot start until UuVector#1 is closed. Stanford CS197 wording is public; this name is the lock.
After adding special tokens, embeddings must be resized and new rows initialized to the mean of existing rows. The locked pad alias is UuPad=eos. Do not invent a new pad token.

Local wandb sweeps in this repo must export UUTILS_SWEEP_MODE=offline-v2 before wandb.sweep and must name the yaml uutils_local_sweep.yaml. Do not reuse the committed sweep_config.yaml for offline runs.

skills.name: accelerate-distributed-training
skills.description: Configure Accelerate distributed training, including config generation and script wrapping.
skills.content:
1. Run accelerate config to generate default_config.yaml.
2. Set compute_environment, distributed_type (DDP first), num_processes, mixed_precision.
3. Gate UuAccWrap: wrap model, optimizer, and dataloader with Accelerator before any backward.
4. Launch with accelerate launch script.py.
5. Add FSDP extra keys (fsdp_sharding_strategy, fsdp_auto_wrap_policy) only after a DDP path exists.

skills.name: hf-training-setup
skills.description: Set up a HuggingFace Trainer: model/tokenizer init, TrainingArguments, datasets, and train().
skills.content:
1. Load the model and tokenizer.
2. Gate UuPadCheck: check tokenizer pad_token before constructing TrainingArguments; do not set run_name prefix (that lock lives in Memory).
3. Tokenize and format datasets.
4. Build TrainingArguments (output_dir, logging, save, evaluation).
5. Instantiate Trainer and call trainer.train().
6. Save model and tokenizer.

skills.name: ml-patent-writing
skills.description: Write a machine-learning patent: background, invention, implementation, claims.
skills.content:
1. Gate UuEligApp: eligibility requires a concrete systems application, not an abstract loss formula.
2. Write background: the existing-art problem.
3. Write the invention summary and advantages.
4. Write implementation: algorithm, architecture, training flow.
5. Drawings: system diagram, flow, results.
6. Claims: independent plus dependent, layered.

skills.name: vectoring-research-planning
skills.description: 使用 Vectoring in Research 做研究规划和不确定性迭代。
skills.content:
1. Write the Essential Goal as a single falsifiable claim about this HuggingFace training run, not a topic sentence.
2. Rank remaining uncertainties by whether they block a wandb-logged Trainer step this week, not by paper-section order.
3. Run at most one vector; stop when metric uutils_vector_gate is logged, not after a calendar sprint.
4. Do not start a patent-writing workstream until that metric exists.

skills.name: wandb-sweep-workflow
skills.description: 运行 wandb hyperparameter sweeps（config、sweep 初始化、agent）；本地 yaml 键在附件
skills.content:
1. Place the local sweep yaml next to the train entrypoint, not under tutorials_for_myself.
2. Call wandb.sweep then wandb.agent from Python with the train callable.
3. The required yaml key and forbidden project string for a local no-upload sweep are only in references/sweep-local.md.
